verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.pt: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel partiu do deserto de Sim, por suas jornadas, ao mandamento do SENHOR, e assentaram o acampamento em Refidim: e não havia água para que o povo bebesse.
verses.en_web: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, by their journeys, according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel went on from the waste land of Sin, by stages as the Lord gave them orders, and put up their tents in Rephidim: and there was no drinking-water for the people.

verses.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
verses.pt: E brigou o povo com Moisés, e disseram: Dá-nos água que bebamos. E Moisés lhes disse: Por que brigais comigo? Por que tentais ao SENHOR?
verses.en_web: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”
verses.en_bbe: So the people were angry with Moses, and said, Give us water for drinking. And Moses said, Why are you angry with me? and why do you put God to the test?

verses.en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.pt: Assim que o povo teve ali sede de água, e murmurou contra Moisés, e disse: Por que nos fizeste subir do Egito para matar-nos de sede a nós, e a nossos filhos e a nossos gados?
verses.en_web: The people were thirsty for water there; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
verses.en_bbe: And the people were in great need of water; and they made an outcry against Moses, and said, Why have you taken us out of Egypt to send death on us and our children and our cattle through need of water?

verses.en: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.pt: Então clamou Moisés ao SENHOR, dizendo: Que farei com este povo? Daqui um pouco me apedrejarão.
verses.en_web: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses, crying out to the Lord, said, What am I to do to this people? they are almost ready to put me to death by stoning.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Passa diante do povo, e toma contigo dos anciãos de Israel; e toma também em tua mão tua vara, com que feriste o rio, e vai:
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Go on before the people, and take some of the chiefs of Israel with you, and take in your hand the rod which was stretched out over the Nile, and go.

verses.en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.pt: Eis que eu estou diante de ti ali sobre a rocha em Horebe; e ferirás a rocha, e sairão dela águas, e beberá o povo. E Moisés o fez assim em presença dos anciãos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: See, I will take my place before you on the rock in Horeb; and when you give the rock a blow, water will come out of it, and the people will have drink. And Moses did so before the eyes of the chiefs of Israel.

verses.en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
verses.pt: E chamou o nome daquele lugar Massá e Meribá, pela briga dos filhos de Israel, e porque tentaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Está, pois, o SENHOR entre nós, ou não?
verses.en_web: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”
verses.en_bbe: And he gave that place the name Massah and Meribah, because the children of Israel were angry, and because they put the Lord to the test, saying, Is the Lord with us or not?

verses.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.pt: E veio Amaleque e lutou com Israel em Refidim.
verses.en_web: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.en_bbe: Then Amalek came and made war on Israel in Rephidim.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
verses.pt: E disse Moisés a Josué: Escolhe para nós homens, e sai, luta com Amaleque: amanhã eu estarei sobre o cume do morro, e a vara de Deus em minha mão.
verses.en_web: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to Joshua, Get together a band of men for us and go out, make war on Amalek: tomorrow I will take my place on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

verses.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.pt: E fez Josué como lhe disse Moisés, lutando com Amaleque; e Moisés e Arão e Hur subiram ao cume do morro.
verses.en_web: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.en_bbe: So Joshua did as Moses said to him, and went to war with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.pt: E sucedia que quando erguia Moisés sua mão, Israel prevalecia; mas quando ele baixava sua mão, prevalecia Amaleque.
verses.en_web: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.en_bbe: Now while Moses' hand was lifted up, Israel was the stronger: but when he let his hand go down, Amalek became the stronger.

verses.en: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.pt: E as mãos de Moisés estavam pesadas; pelo que tomaram uma pedra, e puseram-na debaixo dele, e se sentou sobre ela; e Arão e Hur sustentavam suas mãos, o um de uma parte e o outro de outra; assim houve em suas mãos firmeza até que se pôs o sol.
verses.en_web: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
verses.en_bbe: But Moses' hands became tired; so they put a stone under him and he took his seat on it, Aaron and Hur supporting his hands, one on one side and one on the other; so his hands were kept up without falling till the sun went down.

verses.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.pt: E Josué derrotou a Amaleque e a seu povo a fio de espada.
verses.en_web: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.en_bbe: And Joshua overcame Amalek and his people with the sword.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Escreve isto para memória em um livro, e dize a Josué que de todo tenho de apagar a memória de Amaleque de debaixo do céu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Make a record of this in a book, so that it may be kept in memory, and say it again in the ears of Joshua: that all memory of Amalek is to be completely uprooted from the earth.

verses.en: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:
verses.pt: E Moisés edificou um altar, e chamou seu nome O SENHOR é minha bandeira;
verses.en_web: Moses built an altar, and called its name Yahweh our Banner.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses put up an altar and gave it the name of Yahweh-nissi:

verses.en: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.pt: E disse: Porquanto há mão sobre o trono do SENHOR, o SENHOR terá guerra com Amaleque de geração em geração.
verses.en_web: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
verses.en_bbe: For he said, The Lord has taken his oath that there will be war with Amalek from generation to generation.
